text.en:
Only persons duly authorized by the government agencies concerned shall be allowed to buy leaf
tobacco directly from the farmers.

The Agencies concerned shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement this Decree
relative to the enforcement and implementation of floor prices, subject to the approval of the Philippine
Tobacco Board.

Violation by any person of the floor price policy fixed by the Board or of any implementing
rules and/or regulations issued thereunder shall be sufficient ground for the cancellation or revocation of his or
its permit to trade, and shall be punishable with a fine of not more than P2,000 or imprisonment of not more
than one year or both at the discretion of the court.
If the violation is committed by a corporation or association, the penalty shall be imposed upon the president,
director or directors, manager, managing partner, or other officials thereof responsible for such violation. Any
alien violating or responsible for the violation of this Decree or its implementing rules and regulations shall,
upon completion of the service of sentence, be deported without any further proceeding on the part of the
Deportation Board. Any government official or employee who aids, abets and connives with any person in

violating this Decree or its implementing rules and regulations, shall, in addition to the penalty which may be
imposed upon him as a principal, be perpetually disqualified from holding any public office.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
